q1: SELECT name FROM drinker WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT f.bar FROM frequents AS f, serves AS s WHERE f.drinker = drinker.name AND f.bar = s.bar AND NOT s.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM likes WHERE drinker = drinker.name))
q2: SELECT DISTINCT frequents.drinker FROM serves, frequents, likes WHERE serves.bar = frequents.bar AND frequents.drinker = likes.drinker AND likes.beer = serves.beer INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT frequents.drinker FROM serves, frequents, likes WHERE serves.bar = frequents.bar AND frequents.drinker = likes.drinker AND likes.beer <> serves.beer
